$comment: Single source of truth for site templates and what each tier may ship. Enforced by agency/templates.py (tests, and every Claude Code build). allowed_deps: every direct dependency must match one (glob). forbidden_deps: must not appear anywhere in the lockfile, so transitive pulls are caught too.

T1.name: Editorial
T1.summary: Static pages, CSS-only motion. No JavaScript animation or 3D libraries.

T2.name: Scroll Story
T2.summary: Adds Lenis smooth scroll, GSAP ScrollTrigger and Framer Motion. Still no 3D.

T3.name: Flagship 3D
T3.summary: Adds Three.js for a lazy-loaded WebGL layer with a low-GPU fallback. No scene editors or second 3D engine.

templates.description: Minimalist editorial: Next.js, Tailwind, CSS-only motion (scroll-driven where supported).
Glassmorphism scroll story: Lenis, GSAP ScrollTrigger pinned chapters, Framer Motion micro-interactions.
Flagship liquid glass: lazy-loaded Three.js shader background, GPU tiering, static fallback.
